papers.headline: Reconstruction of Dynamical Dark Energy and Gravity from latest cosmological data
papers.summary: Recent cosmological observations have renewed interest in non-standard late-time evolution.
papers.title: Reconstruction of Dynamical Dark Energy and Gravity from latest cosmological data

papers.headline: TOI-1699A: a sub-Neptune and a super-Jovian in an S-type planetary system
papers.summary: We present the detection and characterization of the TOI-1699A (TYC 3415-00428-1) S-type planetary system, hosted by the G5 V primary of a wide binary with an M3 V stellar companion at a projected separation of ∼348 au.
papers.title: TOI-1699A: a sub-Neptune and a super-Jovian in an S-type planetary system

papers.headline: Quantum Efficiency Measurements of a Low-Cost, Commercial CMOS Sensor in the Soft X-ray Bandpass
papers.summary: Complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS) image sensors offer distinct advantages as imaging detectors for space-based X-ray observatories, being low-power, radiation-resistant, and operable at room temperature.
papers.title: Quantum Efficiency Measurements of a Low-Cost, Commercial CMOS Sensor in the Soft X-ray Bandpass
